svg.aria-label: What I built: Parses embedded documents, so supporting material inside attachments is not missed. Ranks similar past responses to find the most relevant answers already given. Drafts a new answer linked to its evidence, so reviewers can check every claim at the source. Routes each case to the right subject-matter expert.
